answer: A reputation graph that only counts work vouched for by a verified identity thread resists sybils cheaply: every new account must stake real value and earn endorsement from members whose own standing is already bonded, so the fable of a thousand fake personas collapses into one traceable cluster instead of a false zenith of influence. The attacker pays staking capital per node, endorsement fees from honest members, and forfeits the whole stake when the cluster is slashed.
